ServiceHmac.name: X-CF-Signature
ServiceHmac.description: cf-svc-v1 HMAC-SHA256 over version, service id, key id, method, request URI, timestamp, nonce and body SHA-256 (see @cosmicforge/service-clients). Sent over private transport (Unix socket or TLS 1.3 mTLS).

StaffDelegation.name: X-CF-Delegation
StaffDelegation.description: Short-lived HS256 delegated staff context bound to the exact request (see @cosmicforge/identity-and-permissions).
